routine_tools.description: Check in for a SkyLark flight. App: SkyLark (com.skylark.air), on a phone Envoy operates. Starts SkyLark check-in for the flight to the requested city, selects the passenger, confirms no hazardous materials are being carried, confirms check-in, and returns the boarding pass details shown on completion. Only works when trip_city is the one already shown on 'Next trip'. Outputs: seat, gate, boarding time, boarding group, flight (in get_task's result once it's done).
